name: check-custom-loaded
eval: (() => { const ta = document.querySelector('.persona-modal textarea'); const meta = document.querySelector('.persona-meta'); return JSON.stringify({ starts: ta?.value.slice(0, 12), customTag: meta?.textContent.includes('自定义') }); })()

name: check-baseline
eval: (() => { const ta = document.querySelector('.persona-modal textarea'); return 'baseline-loaded:' + ta.value.length + '字, 开头: ' + ta.value.slice(0, 16); })()
